presentation.label: ADHD assessment
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us what symptoms make you think you may have ADHD and how they are affecting you.

questions.question: How long have you felt this way?
Are your symptoms affecting your work, studies, daily routine or social interactions?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the symptoms are affecting the patient's work, studies or daily life?

questions.question: Have you previously been diagnosed with any other mental health conditions?
Has anyone in your family been diagnosed with ADDH or any other mntal health conditions?
Are you interested in taking any medication for ADHD if you were to be diagnosed?
